page.layout: One page of text: running head and page number at the top; a running paragraph; a heading over a two-column table (Arabic month names left, Latin names right); signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: mensis plerunque adscribunt ماه Mah, i. e. Mensem, ut cùm exprimerent Fervardin, dicunt فروردین ماه Fervardin mah, (cujus ratio in Institutionibus redditur) & sic in reliquis mensibus. Æthiopes autem ἰωίρες ἰπποροφέας [?] vocant ጳጉሜን [?] Pagomen, ipso nimirùm Græco vocabulo depravato.
main_text.head: Menses Arabici. v. l. r. c.17:

page.notes: The Greek and Ethiopic words in the first paragraph are small and hard to read; the Greek reading and the Ethiopic word are uncertain and marked [?]. The Arabic script is copied from the scan as far as it is legible. The "In" at the foot is a catchword; "Aa" is the signature. The "Google" watermark at lower right is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
